action: In the Texture Paint workspace the artist dabs large black test strokes on the already peach-filled image 'female_char1' in the Image Editor (Paint mode); by 00:55:13 they are gone again.
view: Image Editor left, 3D viewport top right, second Image Editor with reference bottom right
why: check the brush and the image-to-model link before real painting
reader_equivalent: no equivalent needed; verify the image is assigned by reading pixels back after a numpy write

action: The whole texture is a flat peach skin colour; a second Image Editor shows the concept picture '781797044449899121.png' as a colour reference, and the body shows peach in the viewport.
why: skin is the base colour of the whole atlas; reference stays visible for colour picking
reader_equivalent: bpy.data.images.new(...); fill all pixels with the skin RGB via numpy; load the concept image with bpy.data.images.load for colour sampling

action: Paints a soft-edged dark navy blob over the shorts UV island in the Image Editor; the shorts on the model turn navy.
view: Image Editor with UV wireframe overlay
why: base flat colour for the shorts
reader_equivalent: rasterize the shorts UV island polygons into a mask and set those pixels to navy with numpy (pad a few pixels)

action: Switches to UV Editing and opens the UV menu on the shorts island, hovering Straighten X; the Properties material panel shows Surface linked straight to the image 'female_char1' (Linear, Flat, Repeat, Generated).
tool: UV Editor, UV > Straighten X; Properties > Material
why: make UV rows straight so horizontal stripes can be painted as straight bands
reader_equivalent: bpy.ops.uv.align(axis='ALIGN_X') with the island selected in an Image Editor context override, or set UV coords directly via bmesh

action: Loop-selects a horizontal UV edge row on the shorts island in the UV Editor and straightens it.
why: rows line up so a painted band follows the hem
reader_equivalent: bmesh: for the loop's UV verts set v to their mean value

action: Picks a red colour and adds it as a swatch to the Color Palette, which now holds peach, white and red.
why: keep the outfit colours as reusable swatches
reader_equivalent: keep a Python dict of named RGB colours sampled from the reference

action: Paints a wide red band across the straightened shorts island; the Falloff curve popup is open showing a custom S-shaped curve.
view: Image Editor zoomed on shorts island
why: red lower band of the shorts from the reference
reader_equivalent: fill the pixel rows between two V values inside the shorts island mask with red

action: Back in the UV Editor, moves selected UV rows of the shorts along Y so the red band sits on the intended faces.
why: fit UVs to paint rather than repaint
reader_equivalent: offset the selected loops' UV.y in bmesh

action: Fills the red band solid with a small hard brush.
why: clean flat colour with no soft edge
reader_equivalent: same mask fill, no blur

action: Paints thin yellow stripes along the top edge of the red band and under its lower edge, and a few red strokes; yellow is added to the palette.
view: Image Editor zoomed, 3D shows red/yellow trim on shorts
reader_equivalent: draw 2-4 px lines along UV edge loops (rasterize edge segments with a thickness)

action: Cleans up the yellow top stripe with a very small brush.
reader_equivalent: line raster with 2 px half-width

action: Paints red blobs over the shorts side-panel/pocket islands; the 3D view shows red panels on the hips.
reader_equivalent: fill those islands' UV masks red

action: Opens the image browse list in the lower Image Editor; it lists 781797044449899121.png, female_char1, Render Result, Test.
why: switch the second editor between the reference and the texture
reader_equivalent: bpy.data.images lookup by name

action: Paints a long island dark charcoal; the 3D close-up shows a dark belt with a brown diamond buckle.
reader_equivalent: fill the belt island mask with charcoal

action: Fills small round islands with the same charcoal colour.
reader_equivalent: island mask fill

action: Paints a yellow edge stripe along the top of a red/navy panel at medium radius, then refines at 10 px; the pixel edges show the image is low resolution relative to the zoom.
reader_equivalent: line raster along the island top edge

action: Turns the 3D view to the legs and zooms the reference to the boots.
reader_equivalent: crop the boot region of the reference

action: Paints the boot islands navy; dots of navy appear on the boots in 3D.
reader_equivalent: island mask fill

action: In UV Editing, selects a boot part's UV island and scales it down (Resize) into an already painted red patch, then moves another island.
why: colour a part by placing its UVs on existing paint instead of painting
reader_equivalent: scale/translate the island's UV coords so they fall inside a pixel region of the wanted colour

action: Paints red over shoe/boot accent islands; the 3D close-up shows navy boots with red patches and beige soles.
reader_equivalent: island mask fill

action: Overview of the atlas: soft-edged red blobs over several shoe islands and a charcoal leg strap island.
reader_equivalent: save a preview PNG of the texture

action: Paints red over the lower part of a navy boot-shaft island to make the red front panel.
reader_equivalent: fill the part of the mask below a UV line with red

action: In the 3D view Edit Mode, selects boot cuff faces and runs Unwrap (operator panel 'Unwrap' visible), then resizes the new island in the UV Editor onto painted colour.
why: give a new/edited part UVs and drop them on existing paint
reader_equivalent: bpy.ops.uv.unwrap on selected faces, then transform the island UVs

action: Paints a yellow stroke; a yellow band appears around the boot cuff in 3D.
reader_equivalent: fill the cuff loop's UV strip with yellow

action: Paints red shapes onto a large navy island (chest/top) at the corners.
reader_equivalent: polygon fills inside the island mask

action: 3D view shows the chest cups now navy and the belt brown; artist checks against the reference.
reader_equivalent: render a front view and compare to reference

action: Paints a tan-brown pouch on a navy island with a small brush, then adds a thin strap line.
reader_equivalent: small polygon fills and lines in UV space

action: Adds brown on small belt-piece islands; 3D shows brown tabs under the chest and a brown buckle.
reader_equivalent: island mask fill

action: Picks teal and paints one big teal blob in empty image space, while the jacket faces are selected in Edit Mode.
reader_equivalent: fill a rectangle of teal, or the jacket island mask

why: fit the island inside the painted colour

action: Paints a red blob over the top of the teal jacket island (back yoke) with a large brush.

action: Paints red and navy on sleeve and cuff islands; the model shows a teal jacket with red cuffs.
reader_equivalent: island mask fills

action: Paints a yellow line along a long thin island and a navy patch on a jacket piece.

action: Fills the inside of the yellow V with teal; edges are visibly pixel-stepped.

action: Paints collar/lapel islands navy, then red borders around them.

action: Paints teal inside a red lapel island, then yellow trim along its inner edge.
reader_equivalent: nested polygon fills

action: Zoomed check: teal, yellow and red regions meet with hard pixel edges; 3D shows the jacket front.
reader_equivalent: none

action: Outlines a shape in dark charcoal on a red island with a 4 px brush, then fills it with 16 px.
why: dark inner panel on a red piece
reader_equivalent: polygon fill

action: Zooms the reference to the face; the model's eyebrows and lash lines are separate dark geometry already showing dark.
reader_equivalent: crop face region of reference

action: UV overview of the whole square texture with most clothing blocked in.
reader_equivalent: none

action: In UV Editing, selects the inner eye ring of UVs and scales it up (Resize) so the eye gets more texture pixels.

action: Fills around the eye island with dark maroon, then paints a pale grey sclera crescent and a navy pupil block.

action: Paints the iris pale cream, then lays dark purple at the top of the iris with a lower strength so it blends.

action: Adds orange on the iris sides around a navy pupil, then 1 px light-blue highlights.
why: anime iris colours and catch lights
reader_equivalent: small ellipse fills and single-pixel dots

action: Paints a soft blue streak over the eye area at half strength; the 3D view shows the finished eyes with navy hair.
reader_equivalent: alpha-blended stroke (alpha 0.5)

action: Paints soft pink blush on the cheek with a big soft brush.

action: Fills a small round island near the blush with off-white.
why: unclear from frames (a small light face part)
reader_equivalent: island mask fill

action: Paints the nose as a small pink-red mark and the mouth as a short dark-rose stroke with a 4 px brush.
why: nose and mouth are painted, not modelled

action: Opens the Falloff preset list (Custom, Smooth, Smoother, Sphere, Root, Sharp, Linear, Sharper, Inverse Square, Constant) with Smooth highlighted.

action: Paints a broad muted rose shadow over the neck/body skin island, then softens with a very large brush.

action: Paints navel dot and short curved rose strokes for belly/rib creases on the torso skin island.
reader_equivalent: curved strokes in UV space

action: Lays a big soft rose band under the chest/at the waistband with a large brush, then at reduced strength.
why: soft cast shadow below clothing edges
reader_equivalent: Gaussian-blurred band along an edge loop, alpha 0.8

action: Continues soft rose shadow strokes at strength 0.7 across leg/arm skin islands.
reader_equivalent: blurred mask blend

action: In UV Editing selects and moves islands (Move panel) so they sit over the painted shadow bands.
reader_equivalent: translate island UVs

action: Softens skin shading around the chest island with a skin-coloured brush at 0.7 strength.

action: Paints skin colour at low strength over the rose shadow to soften it.

action: In the UV Editor uses UV > Align Horizontally and moves a strip island; then Select Linked Pick on the finger islands.

action: Body material panel: Surface is the Image Texture 'female_char1' directly (no shader), Linear, Flat, Repeat, Single Image, sRGB, Alpha Straight.

action: Edit Mode on the body with new pocket geometry on the hips.
